portal_hypertension.title: High Incidence of Anastomotic Stenosis in Pancreatoduodenectomy with Distal Portal Vein Resection: An Ileocolic Vein-Based Anatomical Definition.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of the American College of Surgeons
portal_hypertension.authors: Ito R, Ono Y, Kiritani S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：胰腺癌胰十二指肠切除术中门静脉切除术后的吻合口狭窄可导致门静脉高压相关并发症，尽管狭窄的解剖学决定因素仍不清楚。 临床提示：我们评估了肠系膜上静脉（SMV）横断的水平是否影响节段性门静脉切除术后门静脉狭窄。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Anastomotic stenosis after portal vein resection during pancreaticoduodenectomy for pancreatic cancer can result in portal hypertension-related complications, although the anatomical determinants of stenosis remain poorly defined. We evaluated whether the level of superior mesenteric vein (SMV) transection influences postoperative portal vein stenosis after segmental portal vein resection. Patients who underwent pancreaticoduodenectomy with segmental portal vein resection for borderline resectable or locally advanced pancreatic cancer at two centers were retrospectively analyzed.
